verdict.rationale: Issue triage is a fair question for an AI coding agent. The evidence shows Devin can tackle Linear/Jira tickets and connect to issue trackers via MCP. Nothing documents automatically triaging incoming issues, suggesting severity, or routing them to an owner. The 'Adaptive' routing feature sends prompts to AI models, not issues to people, so it is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
